summary: Add six proof-gated, budget-bounded external-assistant read projections and owner-pinned read trust without live issuance

replay.detail: Assistant grants gain an optional read trust pin recorded with a policy revision increment; grants without a pin replay unchanged and deny every read. Consumed read-authorization nonces are authoritative one-use state on the grant issuer member.

schema.detail: Client-v0 adds AssistantReadTrust/AssistantReadTrustRequest, ScgReadAuthorization, per-route assistant query models, AssistantSummary, assistant attention/mission/agent pages, AssistantContentPage, the response-budget-exceeded and content-not-text error codes, six assistant.* reads, the assistant.grant.read-trust command, and assistant response limits. Page.collection now excludes the dedicated assistant page collections.

rules.detail: Each read requires its exact read.assistant.* scope and an approval-once x-st3-scg-read-authorization proof signed by the pinned attestor (which must differ from the shim key) over the canonical payload and request digest. The person is fixed to the grant issuer. Responses default to 4096 and never exceed 16384 envelope bytes; pins may only lower them. Assistant principals remain denied every other route, stream and mutation.

compatibility.detail: Existing person and resource page shapes are unchanged. Assistant attention, mission and agent page codecs accept the optional native sync notice during replication catch-up or divergence. Generated Rust, Swift and TypeScript clients add assistant_* read methods that send a caller-supplied proof exactly once without signing, retrying or widening the budget, and a read-trust grant operation.

downtime.detail: Normal daemon replacement is sufficient; no live grant issuance, trust pin or adapter deployment is part of this change.

manual.detail: Before any read, the configured owner runs st devices grant read-trust with independently provisioned attestor and shim public keys. Live activation remains gated on caller/disclosure policy, feasibility and coordinated kill acceptance; send remains dormant.

recovery.detail: Re-pinning or revoking the grant increments or ends the policy revision, invalidating outstanding proofs. Denied, expired or replayed authorizations disclose no private bytes and need a fresh approval.
